reporting: Percent resistant with number tested and number resistant, by organism and specimen (blood, pus aspirate, urine), all locations pooled; percentages given only where at least 30 isolates (E. coli and Klebsiella from urine).

verification.note: Tables 3, 7 and 8 read from the PDF text layer and compared value by value with the pages rendered at scale 2.2 (percentages printed across two lines, e.g. 1.6/7 = 1.67, read from the image); every printed percentage recomputed from its printed counts. Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages of the five-district compilation.

notes: District antibiogram of secondary and primary care facilities: Regional Public Health Laboratory Pathanamthitta (a standalone laboratory in the District Hospital compound), samples mainly from District Hospital Kozhencherry and the District TB Centre plus 9 other institutions, 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2024, from the KARSAP compilation of five district antibiograms. All figures are percent resistant. 63% of isolates were from outpatients, 35% inpatients and 2% ICU; tables pool all locations. The chapter's totals disagree: Table 1 lists 589 priority-pathogen isolates (E. coli 250, Klebsiella 136, Pseudomonas 90, S. aureus 55, Acinetobacter 34, Enterococcus 24), the location table 605, and the specimen table (Table 3, recorded as counts) 435 (it gives no specimen for Acinetobacter).
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 24 cells (the whole file is the sample), their numbers tested, both row n values and all 29 counts (Table 3, page 66) read blind from the page images (scale 2.5; tables continue onto pages 73 and 75) and compared: 0 transcription errors; organism, specimen and n correct.
